title: polyad.astrivant.com PolyGraph v1alpha1

apiVersion.description: API group and version of this custom resource: polyad.astrivant.com/v1alpha1.

items.description: Split mesh HTTP requests to one Service among downstream node subtrees.

name.description: Unique route name within this graph.

source.description: Local caller node; selects its descendant mesh pods.

service.description: Existing Service in the graph namespace covering all destination pods.

port.description: Service port carrying HTTP, HTTP/2 or gRPC traffic.

items.description: Select a downstream node subtree and bound its share of requests.

target.description: Downstream node path, such as workers/replica-0/entrypoint, whose pods form a subset.

weight.description: Configured percentage of new HTTP requests.

minWeight.description: Smallest percentage allowed by automatic adjustment.

maxWeight.description: Largest percentage allowed by automatic adjustment.

destinations.description: Distinct downstream subsets whose percentages sum to 100.

anyOf.description: Bound proxy-level failures without changing application traffic weights.

outlierDetection.description: Eject endpoints that repeatedly return server errors.

consecutive5xxErrors.description: Consecutive server errors required before ejection.

maxEjectionPercent.description: Maximum percentage of endpoints that may be ejected.

maxConnections.description: TCP connection ceiling; zero leaves Istio's default.

maxPendingRequests.description: Pending HTTP request ceiling; zero leaves Istio's default.

maxRequests.description: Active HTTP request ceiling; zero leaves Istio's default.

retries.description: Retry attempts for failures selected by retryOn; zero disables retries.

perTryTimeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout for an individual retry attempt.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional total request timeout; zero preserves Istio's default.

retryOn.description: Istio retry conditions used when retries are enabled.

throughput.description: Observe or adapt topology using empirical throughput targets within hard structural policies.

unit.description: Application work unit shared by offered and completed rates, such as records.

items.description: Associate measured application demand with an independently calibrated expansion target.

threshold.description: Inclusive threshold in the selected demand signal's unit; defaults to offered work per second.

cheeger.description: Bound exact edge expansion on the simple undirected projection. A cut's ratio is its crossing-edge count divided by its smaller side's vertex count. The constant is the minimum ratio over all cuts. Raising the minimum rejects severe structural bottlenecks; lowering the maximum requires a sparse cut. Throughput policies can select these structural targets using application-reported rates; the constant itself is edge expansion.

anyOf.description: Inclusive nonnegative minimum; raise it to reject sparse bottlenecks, or omit for no lower bound.
Inclusive nonnegative maximum; lower it to require a sparse cut, or omit for no upper bound.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: A throughput tier requires at least one Cheeger bound.

x-kubernetes-validations.rule: !has(self.minimum) || self.minimum == null || !has(self.maximum) || self.maximum == null || self.minimum <= self.maximum
x-kubernetes-validations.message: Cheeger minimum must not exceed maximum.

condition.description: Observation required before admission: started means the execution resource exists; ready means it exposes readiness; completed means finite execution succeeded. Daemons and resources cannot satisfy completed. Readiness loss does not cancel already-admitted consumers.

requires.description: Lifecycle prerequisites that must all hold before initial admission. Admission dependencies must be acyclic; use connections for cyclic data flow.

gate.description: Name of a Gate definition in the same namespace. Admission requires its expression to evaluate to true; false or unknown blocks admission.

slots.description: Admission slots reserved by this node until finite work completes or execution is removed. Must fit the containing graph; this is not a CPU request.

nodes.description: Graph membership in deterministic admission order. Names are unique within this boundary; definitions are resolved in the same namespace.

connections.description: Declarative data-flow edges, including cycles and self-loops. These edges neither block admission nor configure network transport.

mode.description: Finite graphs report completion when finite work completes and resource nodes are ready. Persistent graphs remain active until stopped or deleted. Graphs containing daemons must be persistent.

slots.description: Total admission-slot capacity for this boundary. Node reservations govern admission; Kubernetes independently schedules actual CPU, memory and device requests.

shutdownPolicy.description: Name of a ShutdownPolicy in the same namespace, specifying a runtime limit and termination grace period.

suspend.description: Stop admitting work and drain owned execution while true. Clearing suspension permits fresh execution; this is not an application checkpoint request.

templateOnly.description: Keep this boundary as an inert reusable definition. A parent graph creates an owned executable copy with this flag cleared.

key.description: Taint key to match. An empty key requires operator Exists and matches all keys.

operator.description: Taint comparison: Equal matches key and value; Exists matches the key regardless of value. Kubernetes defaults an omitted operator to Equal.

value.description: Taint value to match when operator is Equal. Omit or leave empty when operator is Exists.

effect.description: Taint effect to match. An empty effect matches all effects: NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule and NoExecute.

tolerationSeconds.description: Seconds a pod may remain bound after a matching NoExecute taint. Omission tolerates that taint indefinitely; zero requests immediate eviction.

items.description: One entry in tolerations.

tolerations.description: Kubernetes taints tolerated by descendant pods, deduplicated across scopes. Tolerations allow placement on tainted nodes; they do not select or guarantee a node.

enforce.description: Keep these constraints in every descendant pod. False allows a more specific workload or graph placement to replace these defaults; an enforced ancestor cannot be relaxed.

placement.description: Placement defaults or enforced constraints copied to descendant pod templates. Tolerations permit matching taints; selectors and required affinity restrict eligible nodes. This does not reserve capacity.

spec.description: Desired configuration for this PolyGraph resource. Compose graph boundaries into a finite or persistent graph of workloads and resources. Admission follows lifecycle dependencies; deletion waits for owned resources to finish cleanup.

observationsComplete.description: All expected immediate graph instances and recursively composed summaries were observed at matching generations. This is eventual generation freshness, not a heartbeat or atomic cluster snapshot.

graphCount.description: Known graph boundaries including this one. Each boundary counts once.

unobservedGraphs.description: Known missing instances or unavailable/stale child summaries. Descendant totals are lower bounds when nonzero.

nestingDepth.description: Maximum known nesting layers including this boundary as layer one; independent of admission dependency depth.

graphsByPhase.description: Known boundaries by their generation-current lifecycle phase; unavailable summaries count as Unknown.

leafNodes.description: Declared non-boundary nodes across observed graph specs. Uninstantiated subgraph contents are unknown.

observedLeafNodes.description: Declared non-boundary nodes with owned execution resources.

pendingLeafNodes.description: Known leaf nodes with no observed execution resource.

activeLeafNodes.description: Observed leaf resources that are not completed, failed or terminating; not a Pod Running count.

completedLeafNodes.description: Observed finite leaf nodes that completed.

resourceCount.description: All known owned resources across descendants, including nested boundary CRs and obsolete resources. Excludes this root CR; each owned resource counts once.

terminatingResources.description: Known owned resources awaiting deletion across descendants.

capacityPlans.description: Known active capacity plans across observed graph instances.

capacityRequestedPods.description: Future Pods in active capacity plans.

capacityReadyPods.description: Future Pods with last-observed usable capacity.

capacityFailedPlans.description: Failed or expired capacity plans requiring a retry.

delays.description: Durable admission deadlines keyed by node name; shared by operator replicas.

token.description: Gate, graph, workload and dependency identities fencing this admission timer.

notBefore.description: Earliest UTC admission time after dependency eligibility was observed.

description: Compose graph boundaries into a finite or persistent graph of workloads and resources. Admission follows lifecycle dependencies; deletion waits for owned resources to finish cleanup.
